audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty is asserted without a single named ability or range, so 'respect every step-up' has nothing behind it.
audit.why: Ki Burst (W) is only 260 range and Broken Wings (Q) is 275 per cast — she must be on top of you. Seismic Shard is 625. The lane is hard because of a range gap you can actually play around, not because Riven is vaguely strong.
audit.corrected: Levels 1-3 are Riven's because her combo exists and yours does not; the fix is last-hitting at the 625 tip of Seismic Shard, outside the 260-275 band where Ki Burst and Broken Wings live.

audit.whatIsWrong: Power spikes never cite a cooldown; the level chart hands Riven First item and 2+ items while the prose says 'This is your lane now' at exactly those stages, and the win rate is 54.68% Malphite over 1388 games.
audit.why: Riven's spikes are Ki Burst rank-ups (11/10/9/8/7s), Blade of the Exile at 6 (120/90/60s) and lethality items. Malphite's are Level 6 (Unstoppable Force, 130s at rank 1) and armour items, because Ground Slam's damage scales off Armor.
audit.corrected: Malphite spikes at 6 and at every armour item; Riven spikes on Ki Burst rank-ups and her ultimate. The two late stages belong to Malphite, matching the prose.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page says the attack-speed slow 'blunts her auto-reset combo' but never states why it is decisive: Runic Blade (P) is spent by basic attacks, so Ground Slam's attack-speed slow directly throttles the passive her burst rides on.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Riven's abilities charge her blade, and her basic attacks expend charges to deal an additional damage.' Ground Slam 'reduces the Attack Speed of enemies'. Slowing attack speed slows the rate she can cash Runic Blade charges.
audit.corrected: Ground Slam's attack-speed slow starves Runic Blade — her abilities charge the blade but only autos cash it, so the slow cuts her real damage, not just her DPS on paper.

audit.whatIsWrong: The late-game breakdown says 'anti-heal stays core' against Riven.
audit.why: Riven has no healing anywhere in her kit — no heal flag on any of the five abilities. Grievous Wounds buys nothing here; armour does.
audit.corrected: Armour, not anti-heal, is the itemization answer against Riven.

audit.whatIsWrong: Trading rules refer to Riven as 'his' twice and describe 'E his attack speed if he answers'.
audit.why: Pronoun errors on a matchup page read as copy-paste and cost trust.
audit.corrected: Rewritten in second person with correct pronouns and the Runic Blade reason attached.

edits.before: Riven owns the opening — she has a real Level 1-3 combo and you don't. Her three Q dashes, E shield-dash and W stun let her step in, stun you and unload before your W armor or E even exist, and your Granite Shield only buffers one trade. Don't walk up to throw Q in her auto range; last-hit from max Q range, take the chip, and let her waste her combo on minions. Your whole job here is to reach 6 with health to spare.
edits.after: Riven owns the opening — she has a real Level 1-3 combo and you don't. Broken Wings (Q, 13s) carries her in, Valor (E, 10s) shields the answer, and Ki Burst (W, 11s) stuns at 260 range, all before Thunderclap or Ground Slam exist. Last-hit from the 625 tip of Seismic Shard and never step inside that 260 band; let her burn the combo on minions. Your whole job here is to reach 6 with health to spare.

edits.before: Riven's window: her Q-Q-Q dash combo plus W stun bursts you before your armor exists, so respect every step-up and farm with Q from max range.
edits.after: Riven's window: Broken Wings (Q) into Ki Burst (W, 11s at rank 1) bursts you before any armour exists — farm at the 625 tip of Seismic Shard.

edits.before: She hits her combo spike first; her dash mobility and W stun own the all-in while your W and E are still locked.
edits.after: Ki Burst (W) stuns at 260 range on an 11s cooldown and Broken Wings (Q) carries her into it — you have no answer yet.

edits.before: Unstoppable Force is unstoppable — it knocks her up through her dashes and your E slows the attack speed her combo lives on.
edits.after: Unstoppable Force knocks her up mid-combo, and Ground Slam's attack-speed slow starves Runic Blade — the passive her burst rides on.

edits.before: Use E's attack-speed slow every trade to blunt her auto-reset combo and out-sustain her
edits.after: Ground Slam (E) every trade — its attack-speed slow starves the Runic Blade charges she cashes

notes: Level-chart conflict I could NOT fix inside the length band: content win[5] and win[6], and full phases[5].side and phases[6].side, all read 'Riven', while the prose on the same page says 'This is your lane now' from the first armour item and the win rate is 54.68% Malphite over 1388 games. Swapping 'Riven' (5 chars) to 'Malphite' (8 chars) is +60% and the applier would reject it, so those four fields need a manual flip outside the band. Also note Malphite's kit file carries a 'grounding' flag on Seismic Shard (Q) and Ground Slam (E); Riot's descriptions say only move-speed steal and attack-speed slow, so I never claimed Malphite denies Riven's dashes. Riven's Valor (E) is a dash and the page's old claim that R 'knocks her up through her dashes' is not something the kit files establish — I replaced it with the verifiable Runic Blade interaction instead.
